name: notification
description: Native desktop notifications when a Claude Code session needs you - questions, permission prompts, task completions, turn completion and API failures. Hooks only, no AI at runtime, never blocks Claude, silent no-op where no desktop notifier exists. Optional title-only mode keeps message text off the screen.

title_only.title: Title-only notifications
title_only.description: Show only what happened and in which project - never the question, Claude's final message or the error text. Use on shared, recorded or presented screens.
